headline: ماذا حدث حين بدأت مستشفيات تستخدم قائمة تحقق في العمليات الجراحية؟
reviewer: AI editorial review using the owner's arabic-editorial-reviewer and english-editorial-reviewer agents (not a human reader test)

introduction_answers.problem: في غرفة العمليات قد يظن كل فرد في الفريق أن غيره تأكد من أمر مهم.
introduction_answers.who: فرق العمليات الجراحية في المستشفيات، ومرضاها.
introduction_answers.change: قائمة تحقق من منظمة الصحة العالمية؛ انخفضت الوفيات في ثماني مستشفيات، ولم يظهر فرق واضح في 101 مستشفى بأونتاريو.

summary: قائمة التحقق الجراحية ارتبطت بانخفاض الوفيات في دراسة ثماني مستشفيات، ولم يظهر لها أثر واضح في أونتاريو، وتشير المراجعات إلى أن طريقة استخدامها تفسّر جزءًا من الفرق.
terminology_evidence: Surgical safety checklist, before-and-after study, systematic review, statistical significance, compliance and completeness are explained at first use or in the glossary.
language_evidence: Arabic and English reviewed with the owner's arabic-editorial-reviewer and english-editorial-reviewer agents; all BLOCK/FIX findings applied before delivery. Editorial simulation, not a human reader test.

mobile_evidence.scope: Automated rendered-layout verification; screenshots retained for human visual review

source_evidence.claim: 8 hospitals in 8 cities incl. Amman, Jordan; 2007-2008; 19-item checklist; 3,733 patients before, 3,955 after; deaths 1.5% to 0.8%; inpatient complications 11.0% to 7.0%

Ontario policy encouraging universal adoption; 101 hospitals; 109,341 and 106,370 procedures in 3-month periods before/after; death 0.71% vs 0.65% (OR 0.91, P=0.13); complications 3.86% vs 3.82% (P=0.29)
source_evidence.assessment: Before-and-after study using administrative data (Urbach et al., 2014)

source_evidence.claim: 20 systematic reviews; 24 observational pre-post cohort studies; mortality, morbidity, SSI and other outcomes favored the checklist; DVT did not
source_evidence.assessment: Review of systematic reviews (Sotto et al., 2021)

source_evidence.claim: 300 studies; 38% described how the checklist was completed; clearer positive relationship for provider outcomes (communication, understanding, safety culture) than patient outcomes
13 observational studies, 17,867 participants; overall compliance 73%; Sign In 76%, Time Out 61%, Sign Out 62%; completeness 51%; facilitators and barriers listed
source_evidence.assessment: Systematic review and meta-analysis (Habtie et al., 2025)

decision: CI candidate PASS only; authoritative approval is successful GitHub Actions job
